title: Haskins original 13-step b–d–g continuum
scope: Official Haskins Pattern Playback sound. Same F1; equal changes in F2 onset. The source calls the syllables “bae”, “dae”, “gae”. Not a new TTS recording.
note: Haskins Laboratories Pattern Playback legacy demonstration. Original synthetic/archival audio from the source institution; the page identifies thirteen hand-painted two-formant syllables with a common “ae” vowel and equally spaced F2 onsets. The archive is a source-provided demonstration, not a verified copy of every stimulus or recording used for the specific 1957 participant experiment. No pitch, timing, or scientific content was edited.
credit: Haskins Laboratories / Pattern Playback legacy demonstration; Franklin S. Cooper and colleagues. Current archive curated by Haskins Laboratories and Philip Rubin.
